mapper.select: SELECT id, pattern_type, pattern_text, source_finding_id, source_url, required_terms, memo, created_at, updated_at FROM t_cleanroom WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT pattern_text FROM t_cleanroom WHERE pattern_type = #{pattern_type} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT pattern_type, count(*) as cnt FROM t_cleanroom GROUP BY pattern_type
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_cleanroom ( pattern_type, pattern_text, source_finding_id, source_url, required_terms, memo, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{pattern_type}, #{pattern_text}, #{source_finding_id}, #{source_url}, #{required_terms}, #{memo}, datetime('now', 'localtime'), datetime('now', 'localtime') )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_cleanroom SET pattern_type = #{pattern_type}, updated_at = datetime('now', 'localtime') WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_cleanroom SET pattern_type = #{pattern_type}, memo = #{memo}, updated_at = datetime('now', 'localtime') WHERE id = #{id}
